definition: A life-prolonging procedure, also referred to as a life-sustaining procedure or treatment, is a treatment with the purpose of prolonging or sustaining life without reversing the underlying medical condition. According to Oxford Medicine, some examples of life prolonging procedures or treatments may include, but are not limited to cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), mechanical ventilation, and hemodialysis. life insurance trust / life-prolonging procedure Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026
